result:
I added a `pause` action bound to Escape in `project.godot`. The HUD now toggles `get_tree().paused` on it and shows or hides a new "Paused" label. I couldn't run the game here, so none of this has been tested.

The HUD runs in always-process mode so it still receives Escape while paused. The changes are in `scripts/ui/hud.gd` and `scenes/ui/hud.tscn`.
